description: This file is a localization module for the Select2 library, providing Hungarian language translations for various user interface messages.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message indicating failure to load results.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user input exceeds the maximum allowed length.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the user input is below the minimum required length.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of selectable elements has been reached.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating a search is in progress.
